what: Tier B checklist: every symbol, diacritic and convention printed on the extIPA charts (2015, 2021, 2025 issues, union) and the VoQS charts (2015v4 and 2016 issues, union), with its definition in our own words, whether it composes from Tier A (IPA_CHECKLIST.json ids) or needs something new, and acoustic correlates with provenance. Built by a research helper on 2026-10-06; the charts are cited, not reproduced.

id_scheme: B: + code points joined with "+" (NFD). Suffixes: #pre/#post for a mark whose position carries the meaning; #dyn for loudness letters; #timed for the timed pause; #voqs where the VoQS item uses the same characters as an extIPA one; B:term:<word> for words; "/" separates alternatives.

outcome_values.composes: every part is a Tier A entry used in its Tier A meaning (VoQS: a Tier A mark applied over a braced stretch; V = engine default)
outcome_values.composes-via-alias: a new letter/mark that a source equates with a Tier A composition; realise through the alias (see composition.ipa_equivalent; approximate=true where the equation is loose)
outcome_values.needs-new: a new letter, a new mark, a new base (F, W, C, L, J...), or Tier A parts with a new meaning (status tierA-reinterpreted)
outcome_values.prosodic-control: pauses, loudness, tempo, braces, degree numerals: realisable as prosody controls, not segment sounds
outcome_values.notation-only: transcription conventions for indeterminacy or non-speech: nothing to say
